name: 示例·杂志
author: Xinkgo
description: 杂志感：正文两端对齐并首行缩进，标题居中带细线，表格有斑马纹

style.body: font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.85; color: #2f2f2f; letter-spacing: .8px; text-align: justify; word-break: break-word; padding: 4px 2px;
style.h1: margin: 1.2em 0 1.2em; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; text-align: center; text-indent: 0; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #1a1a1a;
style.h2: margin: 2em 0 1.2em; padding: 0 0 .4em; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; text-indent: 0; letter-spacing: 1px; color: #1a1a1a; border-bottom: 1px solid #d8d8d8;
style.blockquote: margin: 1.4em 0; padding: .8em 1em; border-left: 3px dotted #b0b0b0; background: #fafafa; color: #6a6a6a;
style.th: border: 1px solid #d8d8d8; padding: .45em .6em; background: #f2f2f2; font-weight: 700; text-align: left;
